title: Fixed-wing ambient landability
note: Facts come from the pack; ALL judgment lives here. Versioned separately from the tiles and from the app so a weight change ships as a small file, not a rebuild. Advisory only.

vetoes.card_text: Built-up area — structures and wires throughout
No elevation data here — nothing is claimed

caps.card_text: 10 m elevation source — the ditch and berm checks cannot run here
Road alongside — assume wires, mapped or not
Wet or soft ground — looks firmer from altitude than it is

flags.card_text: Distribution wires are largely unmapped nationally. Absence of a wire here is not evidence there is none.

aircraft_defaults.note: AircraftProfile carries no class discriminator today, so v1 uses ONE conservative fixed-wing table and lets the two real fields (glideRatio, bestGlideKts) modulate it. Class-differentiated murphy factors wait for a profile field rather than being guessed from a free-text type string.

energy_model.note: Touchdown energy scales the MARGINAL surfaces only, never the hazard term, and is bounded so it can reorder marginal ground but never lift it above genuinely good ground.
